chars.TAHA: TAHA: a skinny tall young Moroccan man of 20 with short curly black hair, wearing a bright teal windbreaker jacket with a white zipper, black joggers and white sneakers.
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a young Moroccan man wearing a red-and-black checkered flannel shirt over a white t-shirt, beige trousers and a black baseball cap.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a big heavy-set Moroccan man in his fifties with a thick grey moustache, wearing a brown djellaba and a white knitted skullcap.
chars.SUMAYA: SUMAYA: a pretty young Moroccan woman with long black hair and green eyes, wearing a lilac hoodie and light blue jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow neighbourhood street, FRIEND grips TAHA's shoulder and tells him shocking news, while TAHA stands frozen with wide eyes and open mouth, totally heartbroken and in disbelief. Two people face each other in open tension. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: FRIEND explains with his hands, pointing down the street toward a house decorated for a small family celebration, while TAHA grabs his own head with both hands in shock. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: TAHA questions another young man in a grey tracksuit at a street corner; the young man shrugs and nods guiltily, avoiding eye contact, while TAHA looks devastated. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: TAHA sprints desperately through a narrow whitewashed alley with blue doors, panicked face, jacket flapping, a cat jumping out of his way. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: TAHA stands in front of a big blue wooden house door, his fist raised to knock but hesitating, sweating and nervous, swallowing hard. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The blue house door is open: FATHER fills the doorway and stares down suspiciously at TAHA, who smiles awkwardly and asks a question. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the open door, FATHER angrily grabs TAHA by the collar of his teal jacket and shakes him, FATHER furious, TAHA terrified with his feet almost off the ground. Comic exaggerated expressions. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the open door, TAHA nervously holds up his hands and fakes an innocent smile, lying, while FATHER raises one eyebrow very suspiciously with arms crossed. Comic awkward moment. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the doorway of the house, SUMAYA appears at the top of an indoor staircase looking down in shock with her hand over her mouth, while FATHER at the door turns to call her and TAHA stands outside holding his breath. Setting: a neighbourhood of a city in northern Morocco with whitewashed walls and blue doors. Main characters in the central area of the picture, calm background at the edges.
